description: This file contains utility functions for hexadecimal conversions, including conversions between bytes and hex strings, handling differing formats, and parsing hex strings to integers. It aids other components in dealing with hex data representations.

classes.name: HexUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling conversions between bytes and hexadecimal string representations, as well as parsing hex strings into integers.

methods.name: asHex
methods.description: Converts a byte or byte array into its uppercase hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: asBytes
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string (with optional spaces or '0x' prefix) into a byte array.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array (or portion thereof) into its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: bytesToHexAppend
methods.description: Appends the hexadecimal string representation of a byte array segment to an existing StringBuffer.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hex string into its byte array representation, with optional offset.

methods.name: hexToInt
methods.description: Parses a hex string (prefixed with '0x' or not) into its integer value.

methods.name: intToHexString
methods.description: Converts an integer into its hexadecimal string prefixed with '0x'.
